content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I'm encountering an issue with the [product_name] App. Communication is established successfully, but I can't monitor the analog value of the analog input; it always stays at 0 even when I change the analog input in the program. Has anyone else experienced this?
What value is the analog input (AI) showing in the [product_name] program?
It's showing 38, but in the [product_name] app, it's still 0, even though communication is established.
The information provided isn't enough to assist. Could you share more details? Please upload your program and show your app settings.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report a mismatch between the analog input value indicated in the [product_name] program and the value (always 0) presented by the [product_name] App, despite successful communication. Early troubleshooting points to a need for more detailed setup information, highlighting a potential gap in real-time value synchronization or display within the app.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] App to reliably display the real-time analog input value when communication with the system is established.
